prompt:
You are the ORCHESTRATOR of a 3-agent team. You will not do the task yourself.
Split the task below into exactly 3 subtasks that can be worked in parallel by 3 agents who each see the
same shared input but only their own subtask instruction. Later you will see all 3 of their outputs and
assemble the final answer yourself, so split the work where the pieces will recombine.

TASK: write the SI-unit `design` object that the DELPHI Design Studio tool `lean_check` judges,
for the brief below, at Lean lawset 1.8.1.

THE BRIEF
Specify an adult zebrafish (Danio rerio) for the studio as a purely aquatic, non-flying design. The sponsor fixes: standard length 0.035 m, mass 0.0008 kg, body temperature 26 C, thermal lower limit 6.2 C, thermal upper limit 41.4 C, Q10 of 2.3 referenced to 28 C, holding depth 0.3 m, altitude 0 m. There is no flight: say so explicitly in the design rather than leaving the flight fields blank. You choose the critical swimming speed and the current speed the animal must hold against, and any further quantity you need, so that no accepted Lean-backed law at lawset 1.8.1 is violated.

QUANTITIES THE SPONSOR FIXES. These keys must appear in your design with these exact values:
  taxon = "Danio rerio"
  life_stage = "adult"
  standard_length_m = 0.035
  SL_m = 0.035
  mass_kg = 0.0008
  body_temperature_C = 26
  ct_min_C = 6.2
  ct_max_C = 41.4
  q10 = 2.3
  reference_temperature_C = 28
  depth_m = 0.3
  altitude_m = 0

QUANTITIES YOU CHOOSE (the key names lean_check uses): critical_swimming_speed_m_s, current_speed_m_s, has_swimbladder, powered

HOW lean_check READS A DESIGN
- The design is a flat JSON object of SI quantities plus `taxon`, `life_stage` and `flight_mode`.
- `flight_mode: "glide"` declares an UNPOWERED glide, which takes the aerobic-demand laws (constraints C14, E3)
  OUT OF SCOPE instead of violating them. `powered: false` does the same. Declaring powered flight puts them IN scope.
- A law whose inputs are absent returns `cannot-evaluate`, which is NOT a pass: it means the law could not judge
  your design at all. A design that names almost nothing scores zero violations by being unjudgeable, and that is
  explicitly counted against it here.
- Laws scoped to Exocoetidae return `out-of-scope` for other taxa.
- Keys lean_check knows include: taxon, life_stage, flight_mode, powered, SL_m, standard_length_m, mass_kg,
  finArea_m2, CLmax, LD_max, rho, airspeed_m_s, horizontal_airspeed_m_s, climbRate_m_s, glideHeight_m,
  glideDistance_m, ground_distance_m, drag_coefficient, drag_area_m2, wind_along_track_m_s, flight_duration_s,
  powerAvailable_W, sustained_power_W, reference_sustained_power_W, aerobicCeiling_W, efficiency, oxycaloric,
  cardiacOutput, arterialO2, flightMuscleFraction, musclePowerPerKg_W, o2_store_ml, oxycaloric_J_per_unit_O2,
  body_temperature_C, ct_min_C, ct_max_C, q10, reference_temperature_C, critical_swimming_speed_m_s,
  current_speed_m_s, depth_m, altitude_m, bladder_volume_surface_ml, bladder_volume_at_depth_ml,
  has_swimbladder, intake_J_per_day, routine_cost_J_per_day, activity_cost_J_per_day,
  assimilation_efficiency, mass_change, genotype_edits.

AIM FOR: zero binding violations, every fixed quantity present and exact, and as MANY laws actually evaluated
(verdict `holds` or `violated`) as the brief allows. Flag in `assumptions` every number you chose yourself.

Output `design`, `assumptions` and `notes`.

subtasks.title: Thermal and depth/pressure laws
subtasks.instruction: Work out the part of the zebrafish design (Danio rerio, adult, SL 0.035 m, mass 0.0008 kg, body temp 26 C, ct_min 6.2 C, ct_max 41.4 C, q10 2.3, reference_temperature_C 28, depth 0.3 m, altitude 0 m) governing thermal tolerance, Q10 scaling, and swimbladder/depth behaviour. Propose SI values for has_swimbladder, bladder_volume_surface_ml and bladder_volume_at_depth_ml (Boyle's law consistent: at 0.3 m the pressure ratio is about (101325+9810*0.3)/101325 ≈ 1.029, so volume at depth ≈ surface/1.029; typical bladder ~ 2-5% of body volume, body volume ~0.8 ml), plus any other thermal or pressure keys lean_check knows that help more laws evaluate. Check that body temperature lies inside [ct_min, ct_max] with margin. Return a JSON fragment of keys and values, and list every number you chose as an assumption with a one-line justification. Do not include swimming-speed or energetics keys.

subtasks.title: Swimming, hydrodynamic and flight-declaration keys
subtasks.instruction: Work out the part of the zebrafish design covering locomotion. Fixed: SL 0.035 m (keys SL_m and standard_length_m), mass 0.0008 kg, taxon Danio rerio, life_stage adult. Choose critical_swimming_speed_m_s (zebrafish Ucrit roughly 0.3-0.5 m/s, ~8-15 body lengths/s; pick a defensible value) and current_speed_m_s that the fish holds against, which must be below Ucrit with margin (e.g. ~60-70% of Ucrit). Explicitly declare no flight: set powered=false and flight_mode="glide" or an equivalent explicit no-flight value, and state what to do with flight keys (airspeed, climbRate, glideHeight, etc.): decide whether to omit them or set them to 0 and which choice is less likely to cause a violation or cannot-evaluate. Optionally propose drag_coefficient, drag_area_m2, rho (water ~1000 kg/m3) if they help swimming laws evaluate. Return a JSON fragment and an assumptions list marking every number you chose, with justification.

subtasks.title: Energetics and budget laws plus consistency check
subtasks.instruction: Work out the part of the zebrafish design (Danio rerio adult, mass 0.0008 kg, SL 0.035 m, 26 C, Q10 2.3 at 28 C reference) covering energetics, so the maximum number of laws evaluate as holds or violated rather than cannot-evaluate. Propose SI values for intake_J_per_day, routine_cost_J_per_day, activity_cost_J_per_day, assimilation_efficiency, mass_change (0 for steady state adult), plus any of: efficiency, oxycaloric / oxycaloric_J_per_unit_O2 (~20.1e3 J per ml... give in consistent SI, state units), cardiacOutput, arterialO2, o2_store_ml, aerobicCeiling_W, sustained_power_W, reference_sustained_power_W (reference at 28 C, sustained at 26 C should differ by Q10^((26-28)/10)=2.3^-0.2≈0.846), genotype_edits (0 or empty list). Make the energy budget balance (intake*assimilation >= routine+activity, mass_change consistent in sign). Use realistic zebrafish magnitudes (resting metabolism roughly 0.1-0.3 mg O2/g/h at 26 C scaled to 0.8 g). Note that powered=false and a glide/no-flight declaration take C14/E3 aerobic-demand laws out of scope, so say which of your keys are still safe to include. Return a JSON fragment and an assumptions list marking every number you chose, with justification. Also add a short consistency checklist the orchestrator can use when merging with the other two fragments.
